narr: Deep moisture over northern Arizona, cooling aloft, and forcing from a low pressure lifting into Montana and Wyoming lead to scattered to widespread showers and thunderstorms over northern Arizona.
ev: Yarber Wash flooded Horsebreaker Road and other low water crossing about 5 miles east of Dewey-Humboldt. A nearby rain gauge measured 3.50 inches of rain.
lsr: YARBER WASH FLOODED HORSEBREAKER ROAD AND OTHER LOW WATER CROSSINGS (VIA SOCIAL MEDIA) 3.50 INCH RAIN GAUGE MEASUREMENT NEARBY.
